rdma_statement.zh: 显式声明：RDMA / SR-IOV VF / IB / macvlan 与 hostNetwork/hostDevice 路径不经 CNI 转发，任何 NetworkPolicy（原生 / Calico / Cilium）与 VPC 安全组均不覆盖该面；集合通信隔离必须依赖 IB Partition（PKey）/ Subnet Manager 隔离与 rail/plane 分区，另见 network/ib-partition-advice.yaml 与 network/rdma-sriov-uncovered.md。
rdma_statement.en: Explicit declaration: RDMA / SR-IOV VF / IB / macvlan and hostNetwork/hostDevice paths bypass the CNI forwarding plane and are NOT covered by any NetworkPolicy (native / Calico / Cilium) nor by VPC security groups; collective-communication isolation must rely on IB Partition (PKey) / Subnet Manager isolation and rail/plane partitioning - see network/ib-partition-advice.yaml and network/rdma-sriov-uncovered.md.

hostnetwork_convergence: 逐 DaemonSet 审计 hostNetwork=true 必要性（GPU 驱动、SR-IOV device plugin、ib-kubernetes），能收敛即收敛
hostNetwork Pod 出网仅放行到显式白名单 CIDR（监控/registry/时间同步）
hostDevice / SR-IOV 附件统一走专用命名空间并登记到例外通道
